annotations.title: Inspect DeFi Frontend & EIP-1967 Proxy Integrity

description: Inspect a live DeFi web application HTTPS URL and optional EIP-1967 proxy contract for supply-chain hijack indicators: missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP), external `<script>` tags lacking Subresource Integrity (`integrity="sha384-..."`), suspicious third-party domains, and EIP-1967 implementation slot state. Read-only inspection over HTTPS and EVM RPC (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `url`, `hijack_risk_score` (0-100), `verdict` (`PASS`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`), `scripts_analyzed`, `missing_sri_count`, and `proxy_implementation`.

network.description: EVM network for reading the optional EIP-1967 proxy contract (`base`, `ethereum`, `arbitrum`, `polygon`, `optimism`, `bsc`). Defaults to `base`.

proxy.description: Optional 42-character EVM EIP-1967 proxy contract address (`0x...`) to read its on-chain implementation slot (`0x360894...`). Leave empty to skip proxy check.

url.description: Full `https://` URL of the DeFi web application frontend to inspect for script integrity and HTTP security headers (e.g. `https://app.uniswap.org`).

name: check_frontend_hijack
